name: The Scenic Route
source:
"The Scenic Route" is a rustic, horror dating sim where you play as Alex, a young woman participating in a hunting competition in the outskirts of civilization. Venture further into both the forest and the hearts of the townsfolk, and you may discover that you're not the only predator in these woods!

[From [url=https://porksbun.itch.io/the-scenic-route]itch.io[/url]]
